independently_discovered_opportunities: Translate the deterministic first readiness gap into one exact nonsecret evidence collection packet.
Cross-bind the canonical suite and release evidence dynamically without creating a self-referential persisted bundle.

product_platform_improvements.problem: The readiness planner names the next gap but does not give Roger a complete field-level collection packet.
product_platform_improvements.implementation: Added a first-gap-only, time-limited JSON/text packet with exact source and V14 binding, provider-specific nonsecret identifiers, required PASS checks, dependency receipts, forbidden inputs, deterministic digest, and closed preview-only boundaries.
product_platform_improvements.before_state: Roger had one exact action but still had to infer which nonsecret identifiers and checks to collect.
product_platform_improvements.after_state: Roger receives one downloadable packet containing only the exact nonsecret evidence needed for the first gap.
product_platform_improvements.benefit: Reduces owner work and secret-exposure risk without opening provider access or live state.
limitations: No external identity or evidence receipt is supplied or accepted by this release.

builder_prompt_system_improvements.problem: The canonical manifest and release receipts were separately valid but not cross-bound in one dynamic, non-persisted check.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.implementation: Added a dynamic acceptance evidence bundle that validates 145 unique ordered commands, working-tree acceptance, exact package/lock/SBOM hashes, both inventories, owner receipt, source and V14 binding, and detached-final boundaries.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.before_state: Operators had to invoke several validators and manually reconcile their identities.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.after_state: One fail-closed check produces a deterministic bundle digest without adding a circular payload file.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.benefit: Prevents omitted, duplicated, stale, reordered, non-PASS, identity-mismatched, or self-referential acceptance evidence.
limitations: It validates local evidence only and does not prove PostgreSQL, provider, deployment, or production state.
builder_prompt_system_improvements.future_build_benefit: Every freeze can run one dynamic cross-receipt check after inventory regeneration.

reverted_or_rejected_innovation_waves: Provider calls, secret collection, receipt persistence, automatic state application, and deployment authorization were rejected.
A persisted bundle containing current inventory hashes was rejected as potentially self-referential.
lessons_carried_forward: Single-receipt validation is insufficient for a multi-dependency launch decision.
Final archive identity must remain detached but should be automatically cross-checked against embedded evidence.

prior_limitations_reviewed.disposition: Preserved; connector validates only supplied evidence and performs no external action.
Preserved; no portal receipt is invented.

deferred_opportunities_with_exact_reason: External adapters require exact canonical identities and protected read-only access.
Applying a valid batch requires a separate authenticated, audited, reversible owner authorization transaction.
Live OpenAI smoke and portal compatibility require protected deployment and exact portal artifacts.
next_innovation_opportunities: Collect the first exact nonsecret GitHub/Render receipt with owner-provided identities.
Add a detached signed owner acknowledgment only after canonical live evidence exists.
Automate post-package publication of the final ZIP and detached delivery receipt.
